outages.description: Fiber optic cuts on ANTEL's (AS6057) national backbone caused a near-total loss of its HTTP request traffic in eastern Uruguay.

Yandex, Russia's biggest internet company, shut down its data centers in Sasovo, Ryazan, and later in Vladimir after drone strikes damaged both facilities.
